integrity: The primary definition and example were inspected in the full published PDF, and the earliest public arXiv date was verified independently. The complete operator equations are reconstructed from the bracket and twisting maps. A standalone symbolic and exhaustive finite-field checker reproduces the classification and the exact parameter counts.
scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the specific three-dimensional BiHom-Lie superalgebra of Example 1.1.
The finite-field corollary is restricted to odd characteristic and nonzero twisting parameters.
The correction reads Rota-Baxter operators as the adjoint special case of the O-operators defined immediately before them, including the two twist-commutation requirements.
title: Twist compatibility repairs the Rota–Baxter families in a three-dimensional BiHom-Lie example
